title: Discovering the Spirit of Polynesian Navigators in Hawaii
speaker: North Shore Aloha
zh: 【North Shore Aloha】在夏威夷發現波利尼西亞航海家的精神（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: In a world that changes with each passing moment, these echoes from the past serve as
cues.en: In a world that changes with each passing moment, these echoes from the past serve as
cues.zh: 在瞬息萬變的世界裡，這些來自過去的迴響扮演著

cues.text: a constant, a testament to human resilience and ingenuity.
cues.en: a constant, a testament to human resilience and ingenuity.
cues.zh: 一個常數，證明瞭人類的韌性和創造力。

cues.text: In the heart of the Pacific, the spirit of the Polynesian navigators lives on, reminding
cues.en: In the heart of the Pacific, the spirit of the Polynesian navigators lives on, reminding
cues.zh: 在太平洋的中心，玻里尼西亞航海家的精神依然存在，提醒著人們

cues.text: us of a journey that changed the course of history.
cues.en: us of a journey that changed the course of history.
cues.zh: 我們經歷了改變歷史程序的旅程。

cues.text: As we sail forward, it's important to remember that we are all part of a continuing journey.
cues.en: As we sail forward, it's important to remember that we are all part of a continuing journey.
cues.zh: 當我們向前航行時，重要的是要記住，我們都是持續旅程的一部分。

cues.text: The echoes of the past serve as a compass, guiding us towards a future where we continue
cues.en: The echoes of the past serve as a compass, guiding us towards a future where we continue
cues.zh: 過去的迴響是指南針，指引我們走向未來

cues.text: Just like the ancient Polynesian voyagers, we too are explorers, voyaging through the
cues.en: Just like the ancient Polynesian voyagers, we too are explorers, voyaging through the
cues.zh: 就像古代波利尼西亞航海者一樣，我們也是探險家，航行於

cues.text: vast expanse of knowledge and experience, navigating our way through the challenges
cues.en: vast expanse of knowledge and experience, navigating our way through the challenges
cues.zh: 豐富的知識和經驗，幫助我們應對挑戰

cues.text: of our times and charting our course towards a better tomorrow.
cues.en: of our times and charting our course towards a better tomorrow.
cues.zh: 我們的時代，並為我們走向更美好的明天指引方向。

cues.text: As we set our sights on the horizon, let's remember the indomitable spirit of exploration
cues.en: As we set our sights on the horizon, let's remember the indomitable spirit of exploration
cues.zh: 當我們放眼未來，讓我們記得不屈不撓的探索精神

cues.text: that lives within each one of us.
cues.en: that lives within each one of us.
cues.zh: 它存在於我們每個人的內心。

cues.text: So if you've enjoyed this voyage through time across the vast Pacific and into the
cues.en: So if you've enjoyed this voyage through time across the vast Pacific and into the

cues.text: heart of Hawaii's rich history and culture, please consider liking this video and subscribing
cues.en: heart of Hawaii's rich history and culture, please consider liking this video and subscribing
cues.zh: 夏威夷豐富的歷史和文化的中心，請考慮喜歡這個影片並訂閱

cues.text: Your support helps us to continue creating engaging and enlightening content, allowing
cues.en: Your support helps us to continue creating engaging and enlightening content, allowing
cues.zh: 您的支援幫助我們繼續創造引人入勝且啟發性的內容，讓

cues.text: us to share more fascinating journeys with you.
cues.en: us to share more fascinating journeys with you.
cues.zh: 我們與您分享更多精彩的旅程。
